therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: Tyrosine kinase inhibition combined with microtubule stabilization
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Tumor cell proliferation inhibition through dual pathway targeting

results.dose_information: Docetaxel 70 mg/m² IV every 21 days; Imatinib 600 mg orally daily x 14 days starting 24-36 hours after docetaxel

context.duration: Treatment cycles of 21 days, follow-up up to 4 years
